import time

class Waitlist:
    def __init__(self):
        self.parties = []
    def add(self, name, size):
        self.parties.append({"name": name, "size": size, "added": time.time()})
    def seat_next(self, free_seats):
        for i, p in enumerate(self.parties):
            if p["size"] <= free_seats:
                return self.parties.pop(i)
        return None
    def quoted_wait_minutes(self, position, avg_turn_min=60):
        return round(position * avg_turn_min / 4)
